title: Update global foreground text token to neon green

requirements.summary: Update Tailwind theme foreground token so default `text-foreground` renders neon green in both light and dark themes across the UI.
acceptanceCriteria: All default text that currently derives from the `foreground` theme token renders in a neon-green color across the app (Header, HeroSection, tabs, panels, tables, dialogs).
The change is implemented via theme variables (e.g., in `frontend/src/index.css`) rather than ad-hoc per-component overrides, so the color is consistent across screens.
Both light mode (`:root`) and dark mode (`.dark`) have neon-green foreground text with readable contrast against the existing dark-green/black backgrounds.

file_operations.description: Change the theme CSS variables for `--foreground` (and the matching text foreground variables that currently mirror it, such as `--card-foreground`, `--popover-foreground`, and `--secondary-foreground`) in both `:root` and `.dark` to a neon-green OKLCH value, ensuring adequate contrast against existing dark green backgrounds. Keep the implementation token-based (no per-component overrides) and do not edit any files under `frontend/src/components/ui`.
